title: An owner can cancel a booking hold that is still waiting for payment or the guest's click

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21: cancelBooking returns ok() for any row that is not confirmed, so cancelling a pending hold reports success and changes nothing. The owner list hides the button for guest holds, but a paid hold has no way out until its checkout expires.

DONE 2026-11-21: cancelBooking now treats a 'pending' hold as cancellable: an admin may drop any hold (paid, or a website guest's), and a member may drop their own paid hold with no notice window. The flip is compare-and-set on the status it read and stamps cancelled_at; a hold sends no cancellation notice or timeline entry because it was never confirmed. Already-cancelled rows stay an idempotent ok(). Tests in lib/spaces/booking.test.ts (cancelBooking drops a pending hold). Open edge: an admin who cancels a paid hold while its checkout is still open does not expire that Stripe session, so a buyer who pays afterwards settles an order whose booking stays cancelled.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
